acceptance: The named outcome has actual source/build-bound evidence; unsupported, pending, failed and unperformed checks remain explicit.
alternatives: Editing or deleting an existing observation loses provenance and is rejected by the current SQLite triggers.
Entry-supplied identity mixes content with context and is rejected by the current CLI.
A new Rust wrapper/runner or Markdown-only policy would duplicate or fail to exercise the current boundary.

cases.correction_is_a_new_linked_row: New stable correction ID with related_entry_id appends and keeps original immutable bytes.
cases.entry_cannot_supply_identity_role_task_a: Each of agent_id, role, task_id, attempt_id, created_at in entry is refused before insertion; original rows unchanged.
cases.invalid_kind_bounds_stable_id_and_dangli: Actual CLI/schema refuse invalid kind, overlong summary, padded ID, missing related row and preserve queue state.
cases.late_known_superseded_attempt_remains_hi: Real tool accepts original assigned worker historical append to abandoned attempt; task active newer generation and all queue rows remain unchanged. No submission authorization granted.
cases.local_context_file_is_not_trusted_runner: JSON fixture explicitly retains trusted execution context/role binding and OS SQLite access enforcement as future implementation gates; no forged-context rejection claimed.
cases.same_id_retry_is_idempotent_and_changed_: Exact repeated entry returns existing with one original row; differing immutable observation is refused, preserving original timestamp and payload.
cases.unassigned_actor_and_mismatched_or_unkno: Assigned context linked to another actor/task/missing attempt is rejected without append or queue change.
cases.unlinked_observation_uses_context_identi: Coordinator-supplied worker context without task/attempt appends null links as permitted by ADR0003; no invented active lease required.
cases.worker_appends_observation_with_context_: Real devlog.py inserts exact worker/task/attempt identity and UTC timestamp into actual-schema fixture; queue four tables unchanged.
cases.worker_cannot_update_or_delete_own_or_ot: Actual schema triggers reject direct UPDATE/DELETE of own and other seeded observations. SQL trigger checks do not imply OS access control.

checks.native_rust_wasm_browser: Unperformed and not applicable; no application/Rust/Cargo source changes.
checks.running_acceptance: Independent real CLI/schema suite required; author does not execute behavior.

decision: Use the existing development/devlog.py append-only command and existing SQLite triggers. Worker observation payload cannot set context identity or update/delete retained rows; corrections append a new linked row. The local command never changes authoritative queue rows.
historical_observations: Known assigned superseded/abandoned attempts may still append history; this never admits a stale Source submission or grants queue mutation.
integration_hook: Executable Development suite invokes the actual devlog CLI with explicit isolated --database; it does not replace the future df-workflow runner.
objective: Define devlog provenance authority; expected: worker append only.
source_owner: development/devlog.py and development/schema.sql, read-only in this Design qualification
unresolved: Trusted runner must supply non-forgeable agent/role/task/attempt identity and enforce filesystem/SQLite permissions. A user-provided JSON context and a local SQLite file do not provide that access control.
df-workflow trusted scheduling/coordinator runtime is absent from the current Rust workspace; this Design witness does not implement or qualify it.
verification: Freeze the cited source decision and a bounded contract example; compare worker append only. Retain decision, alternatives and unresolved facts.
Exact executable commands: TBD at G01 and scoped prerequisite resolution; this planned procedure is not a claim that Rust/browser/provider checks ran.
